name: VR Cornhole Training
summary:
Welcome to VR Cornhole Training, human! 

What lies in store for you is an array of bags situations that we’re looking for you to complete. Each of them provides varying conditions for you to highlight your bag throwing skills. You’ll need to overcome heights, bouncy floors, wild fans, zero gravity, and more in order to prove your mastery over the game of cornhole.
